note: Compatibility identity for this source tree. A tagged release records its Rust commit alongside this file.

modes.shared: one stream for every draw, the production request default
modes.labeled: one stream per label, seeded with FNV-1a 32 of the label and the hexadecimal iteration seed

capabilities.scope: The inventoried Frost reference build and its talent, duration, seed and proc-rank variants in the fixture family, plus 24 randomized variants; the whole RaidSimResult and the logs the application parses into first-fight and averaged timelines.
known_differences: Floating-point aggregates differ from Go on arm64 within 1e-9 relative, from Go's fused multiply-add
Debug logs omit Go's stat recalculation lines, which the application's parsers ignore
Rotations where community fix #622 would change a condition are rejected

capabilities.scope: The application's Arcane reference build and its race, talent and cooldown variants in the fixture family, plus 24 randomized variants; the whole RaidSimResult and the first-fight log.
known_differences: Floating-point aggregates differ from Go on arm64 within 1e-9 relative, from Go's fused multiply-add
